title: The son at the grill
logline: Gully's son, ten, on a stool at the grill from behind, in an apron that goes to his ankles, turning corn with tongs. Gully's back beside him. Two backs, one tall.

panels.composition: From behind: a boy of ten on a stool at a grill in an apron that reaches his ankles turning corn with tongs, a heavy gray man standing beside him, smoke, the bay beyond.

characters.pose: ten, at the grill, from behind

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen from behind, a boy of ten on a stool at a grill wearing an apron down to his ankles turning corn with tongs beside a heavy gray-haired man, smoke rising, a bay beyond, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
